info.title: API-DocTest-List Realestate Listings Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings Status API provides access to the current status of property listings in the real estate market. This endpoint allows users to retrieve comprehensive information on available and sold listings, making it essential for real estate professionals and potential buyers. By utilizing this API, consumers can gain insights into market trends and property availability. This operation is particularly useful for real estate agents, investors, and buyers looking to make informed decisions based on up-to-date listing information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of the listings available. Use this to monitor the state of listings and ensure they are active or inactive as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of the listings. It specifies the necessary parameters and expectations for the request in JSON format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of listings.

ListRealestateListingsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the status for the listing operations.

ListRealestateListingsStatusResponse_200.title: Listings Status Response

ListRealestateListingsStatusResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response structure for the Listings Status GET operation. It includes details about the operation status, reference numbers, result IDs, state, processing time, message, and audit information.
